description: Render a node (or the selection) as PNG and return it inline, with path, pixel size and scale. Scale is reduced to fit maxPixels (default 1,000,000); the inline image stays under 200 KB (one retry at half scale), larger renders stay on disk. Use after layout changes: readback cannot see overlap, clipping or mid-word breaks.

inline.description: false: write to disk only and return the path

name: figma_screenshot
